question: Should Vault provider-outage aggregation rely on `auth/token/lookup-self` as the documented contract for deployments that intentionally remove Vault's default policy?
rationale: The code deliberately treats an inconclusive lookup as reference-scoped to preserve scoped-token compatibility, but the user-facing requirement is absent from the current documentation and the protected label requires explicit human handling.

options.title: Document and keep the probe
